tools.name: query
tools.title: Query the Director (read-only)
tools.description: Run a read-only bconsole command on the Director and return its output. Allowed: status, list, llist, show, version, help, time, messages, estimate, and dot-commands such as .jobs, .clients, .pools, .storages, .filesets, .help. Examples: 'status dir', 'list jobs', 'llist jobid=42', 'show fileset=Linux'.

tools.name: ovfs_status
tools.title: Restore-tree backend status
tools.description: Whether the catalog has the OVFS PostgreSQL extension (version) and whether restore trees use it or the Director fallback. Results are the same either way.

tools.name: ovfs_latest
tools.title: Job chain of a client's latest backup
tools.description: JobIds (Full, Differential, Incrementals) that restore the client's latest state, as Bareos restore option 5 selects them. Pass them to ovfs_tree/ovfs_ls.

fileset.description: FileSet name (if the client has several)

tools.name: ovfs_tree
tools.title: Restore tree of a job chain
tools.description: Directory tree below root as JSON, depth levels deep (1 = root and its children). Directories at the depth limit carry 'entries' instead of children; expand them with ovfs_ls. Every node carries jobid/fileindex (restore identity). Keep depth small.

jobids.description: comma-separated JobIds of the chain (Full, Differential, Incrementals); or use client

client.description: client name: the chain of its latest state (restore option 5)

fileset.description: FileSet name, needed if the client has backups of several FileSets

max_entries.description: most nodes in the result, default 100000

tools.name: ovfs_ls
tools.title: List one directory of a job chain
tools.description: Direct children of one directory (files first, then directories with 'entries' counts).

jobids.description: comma-separated JobIds of the chain (Full, Differential, Incrementals); or use client

client.description: client name: the chain of its latest state (restore option 5)

fileset.description: FileSet name, needed if the client has backups of several FileSets

tools.name: ovfs_versions
tools.title: Versions of one file
tools.description: All backed-up versions of a file of a client, newest first, with volumes.

name.description: file name; empty for the directory itself

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs from the catalog
tools.description: Jobs from the catalog (list jobs / llist jobs), newest last. Filters combine. Example: {"client":"bareos-fd","jobstatus":["T","W"],"limit":10}.

job.description: only jobs with this job name

jobstatus.description: job status letter(s) or name(s): T terminated, W warnings, E error, f fatal, A canceled, R running, …

jobtype.description: job type letter(s) or exact name(s): B/Backup, R/Restore, V/Verify, D/Admin, c/Copy, g/Migrate, O/Consolidate, A/Archive

level.description: job level(s): F/Full, I/Incremental, D/Differential, f/VirtualFull, B/Base

volume.description: only jobs that wrote to this volume

days.description: only jobs started in the last n days

hours.description: only jobs started in the last n hours

last.description: only the last run of each job name

count.description: only the number of matching jobs

long.description: true: llist (all fields of every record) instead of list

format.description: json (default): the Director's JSON API result; text: the bconsole text output

tools.name: run_job
tools.title: Start a job
tools.description: Start a configured job now or at a given time (bconsole 'run … yes', never interactive). Every override is optional; the job resource supplies the rest. Returns the Director's reply with 'Job queued. JobId=N'; follow it with wait_job or list tools.

jobid.description: Verify/Copy/Migrate: the job to verify or copy

tools.name: rerun_job
tools.title: Rerun failed jobs
tools.description: Start jobs again with their original parameters (bconsole 'rerun … yes'). Give jobids, or since_jobid (optionally until_jobid), or days/hours (failed jobs of that period).

since_jobid.description: all failed jobs from this JobId on

days.description: failed jobs of the last n days

hours.description: failed jobs of the last n hours

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel jobs
tools.description: Cancel running or waiting jobs (bconsole 'cancel … yes'). Exactly one of jobid, job, ujobid, all=true or state. Confirm with the user before cancelling.

jobid.description: JobId of the job to cancel

job.description: cancel the running jobs of this job name

all.description: cancel all running and waiting jobs

state.description: cancel all jobs in this state

storage.description: with jobid: cancel directly in this Storage daemon

tools.name: wait_job
tools.title: Wait for a job
tools.description: Block until the job has finished and return its JobStatus (bconsole 'wait'). Exactly one of jobid, job, ujobid, or mount=true (wait until a job waits for a mount; with timeout seconds). Holds the Director session while waiting.

job.description: running job whose name starts with this

mount.description: wait until a running job waits for a volume mount

timeout.description: with mount: give up after this many seconds

tools.name: restore
tools.title: Restore files
tools.description: Start a restore job in one non-interactive line ('restore … done yes'). Select the backups with jobids, or with before (state at that time) or the latest state (default) of client+fileset. Select files with all=true, files (full paths) or directories (with a trailing /; needs jobids), or fileregex. Browse first with ovfs_latest / ovfs_tree / ovfs_ls / ovfs_versions to find paths. Target: where (prefix, '/' = original place) or regexwhere or strip_prefix/add_prefix/add_suffix; replace decides about existing files. Confirm with the user where files go and what replace does.

client.description: Client whose backup is restored (also the target unless restoreclient)

jobids.description: JobIds whose files form the tree (Full, Differential, Incrementals)

all.description: restore every file of the selection

files.description: full file paths to restore (latest version within the selection)

directories.description: whole directories (path ending in /); needs jobids

fileregex.description: only files whose path matches this POSIX regex

where.description: target directory prefixed to every path; '/' restores in place

strip_prefix.description: remove this prefix from every path

add_prefix.description: put this prefix before every path

add_suffix.description: append this to every file name

restoreclient.description: target client if different from client

restorejob.description: Restore job resource (needed if several exist)

pool.description: only jobs on volumes of this pool

tools.name: label_volume
tools.title: Label a new volume
tools.description: Write a label to a new volume in a storage device and create it in the catalog (bconsole 'label … yes').

tools.name: relabel_volume
tools.title: Relabel a volume
tools.description: Overwrite the label of an existing volume (Purged/Recycle status) with a new name: its old contents are lost. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this destructive action

tools.name: mount_storage
tools.title: Mount a storage device
tools.description: Mount the volume in a storage device (bconsole 'mount'). Give storage or a running job.

jobid.description: use the storage of this running job instead

job.description: use the storage of the running job with this name

ujobid.description: use the storage of the running job with this unique name

tools.name: unmount_storage
tools.title: Unmount a storage device
tools.description: Unmount a storage device so the volume can be removed (bconsole 'unmount').

jobid.description: use the storage of this running job instead

job.description: use the storage of the running job with this name

ujobid.description: use the storage of the running job with this unique name

tools.name: release_storage
tools.title: Release a storage device
tools.description: Release a storage device: close the volume, keep the device usable (bconsole 'release').

jobid.description: use the storage of this running job instead

job.description: use the storage of the running job with this name

ujobid.description: use the storage of the running job with this unique name

tools.name: update_volume
tools.title: Change volume properties
tools.description: Change catalog properties of one volume (bconsole 'update volume=…'), or reset volumes from their pool (frompool, allfrompool, fromallpools). At least one change.

recyclepool.description: pool the volume goes to when recycled

frompool.description: reset the volume's defaults from its pool

allfrompool.description: reset all volumes of this pool from the pool (instead of volume)

fromallpools.description: reset all volumes of all pools (instead of volume)

tools.name: update_pool
tools.title: Update a pool from the configuration
tools.description: Write the Pool resource of the configuration into the catalog (bconsole 'update pool=…').

tools.name: prune
tools.title: Prune catalog records
tools.description: Remove catalog records whose retention has expired (bconsole 'prune … yes'): files, jobs, volume (one, or all_volumes), stats or directory. Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this destructive action

tools.name: purge
tools.title: Purge catalog records
tools.description: Remove catalog records regardless of retention (bconsole 'purge'; the Director's 'Purge (yes/no)?' is answered yes): files of a job/client/volume, jobs of a client/volume/pool, volumes (optionally with action truncate), or quota. Requires confirm=true.

volume.description: files/jobs: of this volume (one); volume: these volumes

pool.description: jobs: of this pool; volume with action: volumes of this pool

jobstatus.description: jobs/volume: only jobs with these status letters, comma-separated, e.g. E,f

action.description: volume: run ActionOnPurge for purged volumes

allpools.description: with action: volumes of all pools

confirm.description: must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this destructive action

tools.name: delete
tools.title: Delete catalog entries
tools.description: Delete a volume (and its jobs), a pool, jobs or a storage entry from the catalog (bconsole 'delete'). Requires confirm=true.

pool.description: pool name (kind pool; or the pool of the volume)

confirm.description: must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this destructive action

tools.name: truncate
tools.title: Truncate purged volumes
tools.description: Free the space of volumes in status Purged (bconsole 'truncate volstatus=Purged … yes'). Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this destructive action

tools.name: enable
tools.title: Enable a job, client or schedule
tools.description: Enable a job, client or schedule in the running Director (until reload).

tools.name: disable
tools.title: Disable a job, client or schedule
tools.description: Disable a job, client or schedule in the running Director (until reload): no scheduled runs.

tools.name: configure_add

directives.description: directive -> value (string, number, boolean or array)

tools.name: configure_export

tools.name: reload

tools.name: bvfs_restore
tools.title: Prepare a BVFS restore table
tools.description: Create the restore table <path> from files/directories selected with the bvfs_* tools (bconsole '.bvfs_restore'); use it with restore/run and clean up with bvfs_cleanup.

tools.name: bvfs_cleanup
tools.title: Drop a BVFS restore table
tools.description: Drop the table of bvfs_restore (bconsole '.bvfs_cleanup').

tools.name: bvfs_clear_cache
tools.title: Clear the BVFS cache
tools.description: Empty the BVFS path cache (bconsole '.bvfs_clear_cache yes').

tools.name: acl_modify
tools.title: Change console ACLs
tools.description: Change the ACLs of a console in the running Director (Onesimus '.acl set/delete/clear/copy'). type: e.g. job, client, command (…acl); value: entries, comma-separated.

type.description: ACL type, e.g. job, client, pool, command

tools.name: profile_modify
tools.title: Change profiles
tools.description: Create or change profiles and their assignment (Onesimus '.profile create/set/delete/assign/unassign').

tools.name: configure_update
tools.title: Change a configuration resource
tools.description: Change directives of a resource in the running Director and its file (Onesimus 'configure update').

tools.name: configure_delete
tools.title: Delete a configuration resource
tools.description: Remove a resource from the running Director and delete its file (Onesimus 'configure delete'). Requires confirm=true.

confirm.description: must be true: the user explicitly confirmed this destructive action

tools.name: use_catalog
tools.title: Switch the catalog
tools.description: Use another catalog for this session (bconsole 'use catalog=…').

tools.name: setdevice
tools.title: Set device options
tools.description: Set Autoselect of a storage daemon device (bconsole 'setdevice').

tools.name: session_option
tools.title: Console session options
tools.description: Switch autodisplay (show messages automatically), automount (mount after label) or trace (Director trace file) on or off (bconsole 'autodisplay|automount|trace on|off').

tools.name: restore_tree_start
tools.title: Start an interactive restore
tools.description: Build the restore tree of a backup (bconsole 'restore …' up to the file selection) and open a selection session. Select the backups with jobids, or the latest state (default) / the state before a date of client+fileset. Then cd/ls/mark with the other restore_tree_* tools and start the job with restore_tree_done (or restore_tree_abort). Target options as in 'restore'.

jobids.description: JobIds of the tree (Full, Differential, Incrementals)

fileset.description: FileSet for the latest state or before

pool.description: only jobs on volumes of this pool

where.description: target directory prefix; '/' restores in place

tools.name: restore_tree_cd
tools.title: Change directory in the restore tree
tools.description: cd <dir> in the file selection.

tools.name: restore_tree_ls
tools.title: List the restore tree
tools.description: Entries of the current directory (ls), only directories (.lsdir) or only marked ones (lsmark, recursive); optional wildcard pattern. Marked entries carry marked=true.

tools.name: restore_tree_pwd
tools.title: Current directory of the restore tree
tools.description: pwd in the file selection.

tools.name: restore_tree_mark
tools.title: Mark files for the restore
tools.description: mark <pattern> (files and directories with everything below), or with dirs_only markdir (only the directory entries).

pattern.description: name or wildcard in the current directory, '*' for all

tools.name: restore_tree_unmark
tools.title: Unmark files
tools.description: unmark <pattern>, or with dirs_only unmarkdir.

pattern.description: name or wildcard in the current directory, '*' for all

tools.name: restore_tree_count
tools.title: Count marked files
tools.description: count: total and marked files/dirs.

tools.name: restore_tree_find
tools.title: Find files in the restore tree
tools.description: find <pattern>: paths matching a wildcard.

tools.name: restore_tree_estimate
tools.title: Estimate the restore
tools.description: estimate: files, marked files and bytes.

tools.name: restore_tree_help
tools.title: Restore tree commands
tools.description: help of the file selection.

tools.name: restore_tree_done
tools.title: Start the restore job
tools.description: done: leave the file selection and start the restore job of the marked files (answers 'OK to run?' with yes). Confirm the target (where/replace) with the user first.

tools.name: restore_tree_abort
tools.title: Abort the restore
tools.description: abort/quit: discard the selection, no job.
